DISCOVERY 301, PLAINTIFF JULIA FOLLANSBEE'S MOTION FOR ORDER TO COMPEL RESPONSES AND FURTHER RESPONSES TO SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES AND REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS AND TO IMPOSE MONERARY SANCTIONS IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT MUST PROVIDE FULL, SUBSTANTIVE, VERIFIED RESPONSES TO THE DISCOVERY RESPONSES AND PAY $1,400 IN SANCTIONS NO LATER THAN FEBRUARY 16, 2011. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, NOT REPORTED.

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT MARK WEBB'S MOTION TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT AND DEFAULT JUDGMENT IS DENIED. CCP 473(B) MAY NOT BE USED TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT JUDGMENTS RENDERED IN OTHER STATES. LIQUIDATOR OF INTEGRITY INSURANCE COMPANY V HENDRIX (1997) 54 CAL APP. 4TH 971. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 (301/PJB)
